policy: All 237 baseline tests remain deterministic. Restore tests and assertions removed during the earlier visual migration, using the latest upstream commit already merged into this branch. Midscene adds supplementary user-flow coverage and does not replace exact text, count, ordering, DOM, URL, state, or build assertions.
replacementPolicy: candidateCaseIds and evidence identify supplementary AI coverage only. Every inventory entry must retain a named deterministic test; visual content is not a reason to delete exact assertions.
